title: Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 2017
text:
Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act, 2017
BELIZE:
CENTRAL BANK OF BELIZE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short Title.
2. Amendment of Section 35.

No. 28] Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act, 2017 287
No. 28 of 2017
I assent,
(SIR COLVILLE N. YOUNG)
Governor-General
31st March, 2017
AN ACT to amend the Central Bank of Belize Act,
Chapter 262 of the Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2011, to raise the limit of the amount of Treasury
Notes or securities that may be held by the Bank at
any one time; and to provide for matters connected
therewith or incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 1st April, 2017.)
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Short title.
CENTRAL BANK OF BELIZE (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2017,

288 Central Bank of Belize (Amendment) Act, 2017 [No. 28
and shall be read and construed as one with the Central Bank
of Belize Act which, as amended, is hereinafter referred to
as the principal Act.
Amendment of 2. Section 35 (2) of the principal Act is amended by deleting
Section 35.
the words “twenty times” and substituting therefor the words
“thirty times”.
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
